assembly_paths.help_text: Text file listing one assembly path per line. Mutually exclusive with assembly_dir/assembly_suffix.

assembly_dir.help_text: Directory containing assembly FASTA files. Mutually exclusive with assembly_paths; used together with assembly_suffix.

assembly_suffix.help_text: Suffix appended to each sample_col value to form the assembly filename. Only used with assembly_dir.

metadata.help_text: tsv or csv file containing metadata for each genome assembly. Must contain a column to group the assemblies into colour sets. The column name must be specified in the 'label_col' parameter.

sample_col.help_text: Column name in metadata containing sample identifiers, matched against assembly filenames.

label_col.help_text: Column name in the metadata file to use for grouping genome assemblies into colour sets.

kmer_size.help_text: k-mer size used consistently across the GGCAT, SBWT and Themisto2 builds in this subworkflow. Must match the k-mer size of any existing index (e.g. background SBWT/ATB/GTDB) this output will later be compared or set-differenced against.

sbwt_temp_dir.help_text: Scratch directory for the SBWT build's --temp-dir. Optional -- falls back to a task-local work directory, which is fine at species scale. Only set this to a Lustre scratch path with confirmed free space if running at full background-DB scale (ATB/GTDB), which needs terabytes free.

gzip_export.help_text: Gzip the Themisto2 export's color_sets.txt output. Off by default -- compression is single-threaded and slow at full species scale (~2.3h projected for s_pneumoniae) for no benefit beyond disk space, which hasn't been a constraint.
